title: Peel this page back to read its live DOM
blurb: The same peel as /view-source/, with the DOM as it is now under the page. The text is rewritten as the page changes, and only the lines that differ are replaced.
question: Can the text under a peeled page be the DOM as it is now, including the canvas that draws the page, and keep up with a page that changes every second?
result: Yes in Chromium 157. getHTML({ shadowRoots }) writes the document with the canvas that draws it, a MutationObserver says when to write it again, and the text lives in a shadow root so it neither appears in itself nor triggers itself. How long one write takes on a phone isn't verified: the page reports it.
